Round-robin uses rotating `last_rr_idx`. Least-connections uses min-active with index tie-break. Returns -1 if no healthy backend.  
      Files: `src/backend/pool.c`, `src/backend/selector.c`

      Key: spawns pthread looping every 5 s. Probe sends `GET / HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n`, reads response, checks for `HTTP/1.` prefix. 3 consecutive failures → UNHEALTHY. 2 consecutive successes → HEALTHY. Single failure on HEALTHY does NOT immediately change state. Updates `last_check_at` and `last_response_ms` under pool lock. Does NOT hold pool lock during network I/O.  
      Files: `src/health/checker.c`  
      Verify: `ctest --test-dir build -R test_health --output-on-failure` passes

Time-series `time_series_point_t[300]` (rotate oldest). `metrics_tick()` called every 1 s. `metrics_percentile(p)` copies ring, sorts, interpolates — returns `NAN` if empty. `requests_per_second` and `response_bytes_per_second` return `0.0` (not null) when <2 complete buckets. Health-probe traffic never increments any metric.  
      Files: `src/metrics/metrics.c`  
      Verify: `ctest --test-dir build -R test_metrics --output-on-failure` passes

Depends on Phase 1 completing successfully.

- [ ] 10. **`src/admin_api/json_builder.c`**  
       Key: `json_escape_string` escapes `"`, `\`, `\r`, `\n`, `\t`, control chars <0x20 as `\uXXXX`. All `json_build_*` functions return heap-allocated `char*` (caller frees). Benchmark latest reads ONLY `results/latest.json` resolved from executable path — never from caller-supplied path. Strings from untrusted sources go through `json_escape_string` before insertion.  
       Files: `src/admin_api/json_builder.c`  
       Verify: `cmake --build build --parallel` — admin_api_obj compiles cleanly

- [ ] 11. **`src/admin_api/handler.c`**  
       Key: dispatches 6 routes. PUT /api/v1/policy: reads body ≤4 KiB (reject 413 if larger), validates value, acquires `policy_mutex`, updates policy, releases mutex — invalid update must NOT change current policy. CORS: check `Origin` header against whitelist {`http://localhost:5173`, `http://127.0.0.1:5173`}; if match, echo exact origin back; never use `*`. OPTIONS preflight returns 200 with `Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, PUT, OPTIONS` and `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type`. Admin listener caps at `MAX_ADMIN_CONNECTIONS=16`; excess gets 503 immediately.  
       Files: `src/admin_api/handler.c`  
       Verify: `ctest --test-dir build -R test_admin --output-on-failure` passes

- [ ] 12. **`src/proxy/proxy.c`**  
       Key: binds to `127.0.0.1:8080`. Caps at `MAX_PROXY_CONNECTIONS=128`; new connections beyond limit receive 503 immediately. Proxy worker uses `goto cleanup` pattern guaranteeing `release_backend()` on all exit paths. Does NOT hold pool lock during backend network I/O. Forwards `Host`, `X-Forwarded-For`, drops hop-by-hop headers (`Connection`, `Keep-Alive`, `Transfer-Encoding`, `Upgrade`, `Proxy-*`). Uses `MSG_NOSIGNAL` on all `send()` calls. Timeout constants from architecture.md §5a.  
       Files: `src/proxy/proxy.c`  
       Verify: `cmake --build build --parallel` — proxy_obj compiles cleanly

- [ ] 13. **`src/main.c`**  
       Key: `sigaction(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN)` first. Init order: `pool_init()` → `metrics_init()` → `health_worker_start()` → metrics tick thread (1-second loop) → admin listener thread (127.0.0.1:9090) → `proxy_start()`. SIGINT/SIGTERM handler sets `g_shutdown=1`. Main thread blocks until shutdown then calls `proxy_stop()`, `health_worker_stop()`, joins threads. Exits 0 on clean shutdown.  
       Files: `src/main.c`  
       Verify: `cmake --build build --parallel` — `edgemesh` binary produced with zero warnings

## HTTP status codes (from requirements.md §3 — exhaustive)

| Condition | Status |
|---|---|
| Malformed request line or headers | 400 |
| Request headers exceed 16 KiB | 431 |
| Unsupported method (non-GET) | 405 |
| No healthy backend | 503 |
| Backend connect timeout | 502 |
| Backend read timeout | 504 |
| Invalid/incomplete upstream response | 502 |
| Max proxy connections exceeded | 503 |
| Admin body exceeds 4 KiB | 413 |
| Unknown admin route | 404 |
| Unsupported admin method | 405 |
| Admin malformed JSON/invalid value | 400 |
| Admin internal error | 500 |
| Max admin connections exceeded | 503 |

## Risks and implementer notes

1. **`MSG_NOSIGNAL` not `SO_NOSIGPIPE`** — Linux (WSL) does not support `SO_NOSIGPIPE`. Use `MSG_NOSIGNAL` flag on every `send()` call AND call `sigaction(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN)` in `main.c`.

2. **Benchmark result path** — Must be derived from `argv[0]` using `dirname()` + `"/../results/latest.json"` or equivalent, NOT from `getcwd()`. This is the only safe resolution path per architecture.md §6.

3. **Never hold pool mutex during I/O** — Acquire lock, read/modify state, release lock, THEN do network I/O. The in-flight count is reserved under lock before the connection, then released under lock after close.

4. **`release_backend` on every exit path** — Use `goto cleanup` in proxy worker thread. The cleanup label must ALWAYS call `release_backend` if selection succeeded (track with a boolean flag `int backend_reserved`).

5. **Policy update atomicity** — Read current policy under `policy_mutex`, validate new value, update under same mutex. Invalid value must leave the old policy intact — validate BEFORE acquiring the mutex to write.

6. **rates never null** — `requests_per_second` and `response_bytes_per_second` return `0.0` (double, not null) when <2 complete buckets exist. Latency percentiles return `null`/`NAN` when no samples.

7. **Dashboard CORS in dev** — Vite proxy config routes `/api/*` to the C admin API so the browser never makes a cross-origin request during development. The C server's CORS whitelist still enforces the two documented origins for direct browser access.

8. **Integration smoke test timing** — The test must wait ≥18 s (3 probe failures × 5 s interval + buffer) before asserting a backend is unhealthy. The recovery check needs ≥12 s (2 probe successes × 5 s interval + buffer).

9. **GCC 15 `-Werror` strictness** — All files must include `<stdint.h>`, `<stddef.h>`, `<string.h>` as needed. Do not rely on implicit function declarations. Every function used from another TU must be declared in a header that is included.

10. **`window_seconds` parameter validation** — The `/api/v1/metrics` endpoint must reject values outside [10, 300] with 400. Default is 60 when the parameter is absent.
